profile.headline: Core Product Engineer @ Discord (prev Stripe, Disney+, Hulu)
profile.summary:
I am a thinker, leader, and coder striving to create elegant experiences and effective solutions. 

Full Stack Engineer / TypeScript guru from Minnesota. 📍 San Diego, California

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Core Product Engineer building chat features at Discord

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Building Stripe Connect embedded components for online platforms and their connected accounts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built many customer-facing experiences within the Services / Geek Squad division of Best Buy. Products used by millions of customers nationwide.

Engineered new Best Buy live chat platform – used by 1.3 million customers each month. Stack: React web app communicating via web sockets with a Socket.io NodeJS server, coordinating messaging over Kafka.

Created scheduling portals for in-home and in-store repairs, tools for customers to find customer support for their purchases, and self-service payment interfaces for Geek Squad and Best Buy Total Tech Support.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
Agile team member delivering full stack web applications using AngularJS, .NET microservices, and Kafka.

Engineered customer-facing marketing tools to help customers visualize the product in their home. Our team’s customer tools increased sales conversion 5-fold.

Engineered internal product quality and design software used within the manufacturing division.

Lead and coordinated development with offshore development team. Mentored intern developers on front-end development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Front-end developer for corporate marketing website, as well as continuous ongoing web projects for clients including marketing and eCommerce solutions.

positions.title: Web Designer Intern
positions.description: Graphically designed and developed web applications for clients using content management systems.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Development of translation software tools in .NET.

organizations.name: AIAA Design Build Fly
organizations.description: Led electronics sub-team to make design decisions and calculations regarding flight controllers, motor system, servo system, load doors, and flight control surfaces in order to collaborate with body design sub-team and wing design sub-team.

organizations.name: Innovative Engineers
organizations.description: Designed and managed the manufacturing of a crossflow micro-hydroturbine as a clean energy source using Solid Works 3D CAD Software. After initial design completion, traveled to Nicaragua and implemented the design at a testing facility at the National Engineering University of Nicaragua.
